hero.title: Vietnam Buyer Guide
hero.description: Vietnam Buyer Guide is committed to becoming the best business partner for Vietnamese Chinese enterprises, providing comprehensive company information and business matching services, promoting communication and cooperation among Vietnamese Chinese enterprises.

about.title: About Vietnam Buyer Guide
about.paragraph1: Vietnam Buyer Guide is the digital extension and upgrade of the Vietnam Chinese Business Procurement Directory, combining the convenience and real-time nature of the Internet to provide a 24/7 business exchange platform for global Chinese enterprises. Whether you use a computer, laptop, tablet or smartphone, you can log in to the platform at any time, browse the most complete and accurate industry information, and grasp the latest business opportunities and market dynamics in Vietnam and ASEAN regions.
about.paragraph2: We believe that information transparency and close connections are the keys to Chinese business success. Through Vietnam Buyer Guide, companies are no longer limited by the update cycle of printed directories, but can update supply and demand in real time, expand networks, and deepen cooperation, truly achieving "anytime, anywhere, endless business opportunities".
about.paragraph3: Through years of efforts, we have established a complete corporate database covering all industries, including textiles, footwear, vehicles, furniture, building materials, electronics, machinery, plastics, agriculture, metals and many other industrial fields. Every year we update and publish the latest procurement directory to ensure the timeliness and accuracy of information.

history.title: Development History
history.description: Since its launch in 2016, the Vietnam Chinese Business Procurement Directory has continued to deepen its presence in the Vietnamese Chinese business market, gradually developing into the most influential business information platform.

directory.title: Explore Vietnam Chinese Business Procurement Directory
directory.description: The Vietnam Chinese Business Procurement Directory we publish annually contains detailed information on thousands of quality Chinese enterprises. From 2016 to the present, we have published multiple editions, each of which has been strictly reviewed and updated.

2016.title: Foundation Year
2016.description: The Vietnam Chinese Business Procurement Directory was officially launched, establishing a complete enterprise information platform for Vietnamese Chinese businesses for the first time.

2018.title: Industry Expansion
2018.description: Coverage expanded from the original textiles and footwear to diverse fields including electronics, machinery, plastics, and more.

2020.title: Digital Transformation
2020.description: Launched the Vietnam Buyer Guide online platform, breaking through print limitations to provide 24/7 business services.

2022.title: International Connections
2022.description: Established partnerships with chambers of commerce in Taiwan, China, and Southeast Asia, expanding the business network.

2024.title: Smart Upgrade
2024.description: Introduced intelligent search and business matching features, enhancing platform user experience and business conversion rates.
